title: Midnight, in the city of the caliphs… | Folio 4 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
Midnight, in the city of the caliphs. A man sits on the executioner's mat, his eyes bound, a drawn sword beside him. Across the city, an old judge wakes from his sleep, and cannot say why his heart is so heavy.

The full story: Folio 4: The Judge Who Lied to Save a Life — on our channel and on every podcast app.
